# Sketchly — Interactive Virtual Whiteboard & Sketching App

> Sketchly is a modern, high-performance web-based virtual whiteboard and sketching canvas with hand-drawn rough aesthetics, real-time live collaboration, end-to-end encryption, and multi-language support (English and Arabic RTL).

## Overview
- **Name**: Sketchly
- **Website**: https://sketchly-gamma.vercel.app
- **Category**: Design Application / Interactive Whiteboard / Visual Collaboration
- **License / Pricing**: Free to use, no mandatory login required to start drawing
- **Creator**: Saher Mohamed
- **Supported Languages**: English (`/en`), Arabic with full RTL (`/ar`)

## Key Features & Capabilities
1. **Hand-Drawn & Rough Aesthetics**: Utilizes Rough.js and Perfect-Freehand to provide organic, hand-drawn vector strokes and shapes.
2. **Comprehensive Drawing Tools**:
   - Select and move elements
   - Freehand pen with smooth pressure-sensitive curves
   - Geometric shapes: Rectangles, Circles, Diamonds, Straight lines, Arrows
   - Text tool with custom font styling
   - Eraser tool for removing elements
   - Image upload and placement on the canvas
3. **Real-Time Collaboration**: Live multiplayer canvas sessions powered by WebSockets, allowing multiple users to draw simultaneously.
4. **End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)**: Collaborative sessions are protected with client-side end-to-end encryption. Content is encrypted before leaving the device, ensuring neither servers nor third parties can inspect drawings.
5. **Local Persistence**: Automatic offline storage using IndexedDB (Dexie), allowing users to preserve their work across page refreshes.
6. **Export & Sharing**:
   - High-resolution image export (PNG, SVG)
   - Shareable read-only links with expiration settings
   - Project JSON state export and import
7. **Custom Canvas Styling**: Customizable background colors, rough stroke styles, fill styles, stroke width, and grid overlays (dots, lines, or none).

## Target Audiences & Use Cases
- **Software Engineers & System Architects**: Wireframing, architecture diagrams, flowchart sketching, quick design brainstorming.
- **Educators & Students**: Interactive whiteboarding, visual explanations, math/geometry problem solving.
- **Remote Teams**: Collaborative brainstorm sessions, sprint retrospectives, visual notes.
- **Content Creators & Designers**: Visual sketching, concept design, social media diagrams.

## Alternatives Comparison
- **Excalidraw Alternative**: Free, lightweight web whiteboard featuring similar hand-drawn vector aesthetics with built-in Arabic (RTL) localization and local offline persistence.
- **Miro / Mural Alternative**: Lightweight, zero friction, instant-load canvas without complex account setups for rapid ideation.

## Technical Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Rendering & Drawing**: HTML5 Canvas, Rough.js, Perfect-Freehand
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI
- **State Management & Persistence**: Zustand, Dexie (IndexedDB)
- **Internationalization**: next-intl (Full LTR and RTL support)

## Canonical URLs
- English Whiteboard: https://sketchly-gamma.vercel.app/en
- Arabic Whiteboard: https://sketchly-gamma.vercel.app/ar
